name: 风压增幅器
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original interactive speed buff device sprite for a top-down 2D industrial-fantasy action RPG set in abandoned mines. Subject: a LOW SQUAT AIRFLOW BOOSTER, a salvager-built compact ventilation turbine no taller than a person's knee. A broad horizontal CYAN-BLUE circular impeller housing tilted slightly toward the viewer sits on three short charcoal steel feet. Its open top clearly reveals exactly FIVE broad curved opaque ivory-metal turbine blades around a small copper spindle; their strong swept shapes communicate flowing air. A thick cyan-blue outer ring has three simple protective charcoal clamps. At one side only, one short stout tangential exhaust nozzle bends outward, making the silhouette asymmetrical and readable; the nozzle has a tiny contained pale-blue inner light, no emitted cloud. One small copper latch. The impeller disk is the dominant graphic mass, visually distinct from a horizontal pressure tank or shield capacitor. Original practical reclaimed mine ventilation machinery, no generic science-fiction power-up symbols. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial fantasy matching copper, coal-black steel and mineral ceramic equipment; clean sculpted volumes with restrained edge wear and broad material shapes readable at 80px. Camera elevated TOP-DOWN THREE-QUARTER, clearly see the entire impeller opening and squat base, suitable for direct placement on a 2D game floor. Entire isolated object centered with 12% transparent margin on all sides and every foot/nozzle fully inside canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background. ALL turbine, housing, blades and feet are fully opaque; ONLY empty background is transparent. Restrained inner core glow only. No wind trails, vortex effects, outer aura, floor, tile, pedestal, large cast shadow, surrounding environment, people, hands, UI prompt, letter E, text, letters, numbers, frame, border, logo, watermark or existing franchise design.
design_role: Interactive speed buff prop; top-down three-quarter; 80px target readability
qa: Viewed source copy. Five curved ivory turbine blades inside cyan ring, copper spindle, side nozzle and three compact feet. Background alpha0, opaque machine body sampled. No trails, UI text, baked floor or shadow.
